summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on various enhancements, including the integration work with Spark and proposals for the REST catalog. Notable topics include credential management for encryption, recursive namespace listing, and the introduction of relative paths in the v4 spec.
highlights: Iceberg Spark Community Sync notes on integration work
Discussion on optimizing metadata.json write path
Proposal for recursive namespace listing in REST catalog
Introduction of relative paths to v4 spec
